Document Extraction Sample
Introduction
This sample document is designed to test document extraction. It contains real heading styles, body paragraphs, metadata, and a bordered table.
Purpose
The purpose of this document is to provide consistent content in DOCX and PDF formats so that extracted text, headings, metadata, and table structure can be validated.
Test Data
A document parser should identify the title, heading hierarchy, body text, table headers, table rows, author, subject, and other available document properties.
